summary.text: Scott Montgomery is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 32 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Scott Montgomery was born in Spartanburg, South Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree from Hampden-Sydney College.
His career experience includes working as a businessman.
He assumed office on November 11, 2024, succeeding Max Hyde, and the Republican primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
